products.name: Munch
products.note: Content repurposing AI; auto-editing; social clips; trend analysis; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
Munch is an Israeli-based company operating under the brand Munch Studio, offering an AI-powered social media content service aimed at businesses. The company describes itself as providing done-for-you social media content that is on-brand, on-time, and hands-free, with its AI engine generating posts in minutes based on a custom content strategy built for each business.

The company's primary product, also called Munch, falls in the video generation and editing category, with capabilities that include content repurposing, auto-editing, social clip creation, and trend analysis. The site positions the service as a way for businesses to maintain a consistent social media presence without manual effort.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are noted in the available data for Munch.
